questions.question: Agree the proposed title Niccolò Tartaglia: the source has no separate name heading, and its historical opening is retained in full. Clarify the scope of the comparison with mathematicians in the East.

localizations.source: Agree the proposed title Niccolò Tartaglia: the source has no separate name heading, and its historical opening is retained in full. Clarify the scope of the comparison with mathematicians in the East.
localizations.ru: Согласовать заголовок «Никколо Тарталья»: в исходнике нет отдельного именного заголовка, а историческое вступление сохранено полностью. Уточнить рамки сравнительного утверждения о достижениях математиков Востока.

questions.resolution: The comparative claim was narrowed to an independent European achievement; the title was accepted.

questions.question: Verify the types of educational institutions in Verona, Brescia and Venice described as universities, the conditions of Cardano’s receipt of the rule, and the precise titles and dates of the polemical documents.

localizations.source: Verify the types of educational institutions in Verona, Brescia and Venice described as universities, the conditions of Cardano’s receipt of the rule, and the precise titles and dates of the polemical documents.
localizations.ru: Проверить типы учебных заведений в Вероне, Брешии и Венеции, названных университетами, условия передачи правила Кардано и точные названия и даты полемических документов.

questions.resolution: The Verona school type and polemical-document titles were clarified from the Galileo Project, Treccani and Museo Galileo catalogue.

questions.question: Establish the primary source of the engraved portrait of Niccolò Tartaglia, its artist or engraver and date (if known), and the licence or verified public-domain status.

localizations.source: Establish the primary source of the engraved portrait of Niccolò Tartaglia, its artist or engraver and date (if known), and the licence or verified public-domain status.
localizations.ru: Установить первоисточник гравированного портрета Никколо Тартальи, автора или гравёра и дату (если известны), а также лицензию либо подтверждённый статус общественного достояния.

questions.question: Clarify which forms of the cubic equation Tartaglia independently solved in 1535 and which had earlier been solved by del Ferro; wording that he “rediscovered methods already known” should not conflate priority and distinct equation forms.

localizations.source: Clarify which forms of the cubic equation Tartaglia independently solved in 1535 and which had earlier been solved by del Ferro; wording that he “rediscovered methods already known” should not conflate priority and distinct equation forms.
localizations.ru: Уточнить, какие именно формы кубического уравнения независимо решил Тарталья в 1535 году и какие ранее решил дель Ферро; формулировка «переоткрыл известные приёмы» не должна смешивать приоритеты и разные формы уравнения.
